text:
ashley: Heads-up — TLS/CA break when using Python SDK in VPC behind corp proxy. SDK ignores our custom CA and base_url override.

miranda: Small repro? env vs arg?

ashley: Repro:

```python
from redwood import InferenceClient
c = InferenceClient(base_url="https://redwood-private.internal", api_key="x...")
resp = c.generate("hello")
```

It ends up calling public api and cert validation fails.

sam: Which HTTP backend (requests/httpx)?

ashley: Sync/requests. Proxy MITM with company CA. Tried REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE & SSL_CERT_FILE, still fails.

dennis: Known parity bug: no way to inject requests.Session; some paths prefer REDWOOD_API_BASE env over constructor arg.

miranda: Workaround if available: pass custom session:

```python
import requests
s = requests.Session()
s.verify = "/etc/certs/company.pem"
s.trust_env = True
c = InferenceClient(base_url="https://redwood-private.internal", http_session=s, api_key="...")
```

ashley: pip 0.9.1 lacks http_session arg — TypeError.

sam: Action: add http_session (sync) and http_client (async) injection, honor constructor arg > env > defaults, accept verify/ca_bundle param, and surface cert-failure guidance.

miranda: Filed DEVEX-4523 with repro & tests. Ops note: staging + two enterprise tenants affected; temporary fallback applied.

ashley: Can we get a hotfix? Onboarding blocked.

miranda: Prioritizing patch: tests, docs example for VPC+proxy+CA, example app, then patch release. PR incoming — please review API design.
